caption: Distribution of Content Types in the DODa
model_annotation: This donut chart, titled “Distribution of Content Types in the DODa” from the paper “The Evolution of Darija Open Dataset Introducing Version 2,” visually represents the breakdown of six distinct content categories within the dataset, with each category shown as a colored segment and its corresponding numerical value labeled inside the segment. The chart features a legend on the right that maps colors to categories: “Moroccan Names” (orange), “Semantic Categories (e.g., Food, Economy)” (dark purple), “Syntactic Roles (e.g., Verbs, Nouns, Adjectives)” (brown-orange), “Translated Sentences” (yellow), “Extra + Augmented Data” (blue-gray), and “Pending Translations” (light green). The largest segment is “Pending Translations” at 43,000, followed by “Translated Sentences” at 45,387, “Extra + Augmented Data” at 30,000, “Syntactic Roles” at 23,108, “Moroccan Names” (a very thin slice with no visible number), and “Semantic Categories” (an extremely thin slice with no visible number). The chart is a donut chart with a white center hole, and the segments appear to be arranged in descending order of size, with the largest at the top left and the smallest at the top right.
